snippet.title: Chiklet’s Human Products – Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Add to your Wishlist on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643250/Chiklets_Human_Products/

Welcome to Chiklet’s Human Products — a reverse farming simulator where chickens rule the world and humans become the harvest.
Hunt wild humans, harvest their Meat, Bones, Hair, and Skin to craft bizarre recipes and sell them for profit. Build, expand, and automate your strange farm in this darkly humorous twist on the farming genre.

🧩 Features:
– Play as a chicken managing a human farm
– Hunt, harvest, and craft weird recipes
– Explore islands full of resources and dangers
– Build machines to automate your production
– Upgrade your TukTuk and travel across Homo Haven
– Face monsters, uncover mysteries, and restore your grandpa’s legacy

💀 A farming game… but you’re not the farmer anymore.
